run_dash_app: run the CrypTen benchmarks Dash app in debug mode with app.run_server
update_runtime_crypten: update the Crypten runtime bar chart filtered by date and party mode
update_runtime_crypten_v_plain: update the Crypten vs Plaintext runtime gap bar chart by date and mode
process_comparison_options: filter model benchmark data by CPU vs GPU or CPU vs Plaintext comparison option
display_page: route to the index or compare page layout based on the URL pathname
